gates.citation: Granger CWJ (1969). Investigating causal relations by econometric models. Econometrica 37(3):424-438. Geweke J (1982). JASA 77:304-313. Reference impls: statsmodels.tsa.stattools.grangercausalitytests (Seabold & Perktold 2010) + independent numpy OLS (Harris et al. 2020). Data: BIDMC PPG and Respiration Dataset (Pimentel et al. 2017), PhysioNet.

reference.citation: Granger CWJ (1969). Investigating causal relations by econometric models. Econometrica 37(3):424-438. Geweke J (1982). JASA 77:304-313. Reference impls: statsmodels.tsa.stattools.grangercausalitytests (Seabold & Perktold 2010) + independent numpy OLS (Harris et al. 2020). Data: BIDMC PPG and Respiration Dataset (Pimentel et al. 2017), PhysioNet.
reference.description: re-computes both-direction time-domain Granger causality with statsmodels' grangercausalitytests (restricted/unrestricted OLS SSR log-ratio) and an independent numpy OLS on the same demeaned BIDMC resp/PPG signals; reports the op's GC both ways, the net direction, the max |op - statsmodels| (~1e-7) and max |op - independent OLS| (~1e-9) agreement, and the statsmodels F-statistic (both directions significant)
